softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes_no.was: RED at 5f281d81 on sm_80/86/89/90, byte-identically: `softmax f16 dscores[35]: cpu -0.0010614395 vs cuda -0.0010671616 (bound 1.9073486e-6)` at last=257, rows=2 (n=514). The loop aborted there, so last 513/1024/4096 had NEVER been evaluated on any arch.
softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes_no.root_cause: NOT a kernel defect. `softmax_bwd_dscores_f16` meets guide 3.10's regime (all-f32, one rounding point at the final cast, no __half2 path, no f16 temporary); isolating it with an identical `y` moves dscores by at most ONE f16 ULP at every length. The divergence is the FORWARD's: `softmax_fwd_f16`'s f32 row sum is a 256-way strided partial folded through a shared-memory tree while `softmax_row_f16` folds sequentially in ascending index order, and although the two f32 sums agree to 3.3e-7 relative (7.63e-6 of 23.1259 at last=257) that is enough to move `e_i / sum` across an f16 round-to-nearest midpoint. At last=257 exactly two of the row's 257 quotients straddle: y[68]'s exact quotients are 0.029258731 and 0.029258722 against the midpoint 0.029258728. The resulting 1-ULP flip in a large y_j is worth dy_j*ulp(y_j) in `dot` (|Ddot| = 1.46e-4, a hundredfold jump over the ~1e-6 the backward's own fold order contributes), and `dscores_i = (dy_i - dot)*y_i` is 317x cancelled at i=35 (|dy_i| = 7.832 vs |dy_i - dot| = 0.0247), turning that into 6 f16 ULPs of a 1.06e-3 result.
softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes_no.fix: The bound gained the two mechanisms it omitted, as separate additive terms (`softmax_f16_dscores_propagation_terms`, `softmax_f16_dscores_dot_fold_terms`); k stayed at 2. The propagation term is provably ZERO when the two forwards agree bitwise, so at the four lengths where they do, the bound is bit-for-bit the pre-fix one.
softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes_no.note: 513/1024/4096 are FIRST-EVER measurements on any arch — the pre-fix loop never reached them. Every forced-defect control on this leg still fires at ~1e5x over bound.

geglu_f16_fwd_zero_headroom_closed.was: worst delta/bound EXACTLY 1.0 at n_out=1024 on both sm_80 (the a100 artifact) and sm_89 (re-measured here at 5f281d81) — the only bound in either kernels leg sitting on its own worst case.
geglu_f16_fwd_zero_headroom_closed.root_cause: `k = 2` was read off guide 3.10's rounding-point COUNT. ROUND 1 (`cuda/geglu_f16.cu:57`, the activation cast) sits UPSTREAM of `:58`'s multiply: the two arms' pre-ROUND-1 activations differ by ~1 f32 ULP (CUDA `erff` vs the CPU reference's `erf`) and can straddle an f16 midpoint — 384 of 1024 elements are within one f32 ULP of one on this fixture — so |Dact| <= 1 ulp(act), a relative 2^-10, which `act*up` carries into `out` as up to 2 ULPs of out, on top of ROUND 2's own <=1. Derived k = 3.
geglu_f16_fwd_zero_headroom_closed.note: Headroom is 1.5x BY CONSTRUCTION at n_out=1024 — a worst-case-derived bound against a near-worst-case sample. Not a kernel defect: `geglu_f16.cu` implements exactly the two-rounding-point regime the table states. The bf16 twin takes the same derived k (identical structure); its observed ratios are 0.0/0.010/0.333.
